# Input
Atlas Input — single-line text entry. Variant × Size × State (45 total).

USE WHEN
· One line of text, email, number, search or password.

DON'T USE WHEN
· Multi-line text → Textarea.
· Choosing from a fixed set → Select, or RadioGroup for 2–6 visible options.

DO
· Pair every Input with a Label whose htmlFor matches the input id.
· Show State=error together with a visible error message, not colour alone.

DON'T
· Use placeholder text as the only label.
· Put a currency or unit in the placeholder.
· Disable an input to show read-only content.

PROPERTIES
Variant: default | filled | unstyled (unstyled when the surrounding container owns the border: search bars, inline edit). Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | hover | focus-visible | disabled | error.
